t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Red brown and purple gnomes are connected to red basket, the yellow blue light brown and green are connected to yellow. Switch when one seems like it's giving less mushrooms go back and forth because it seems like the forests restock mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: The red, pink, and brown gnomes are connected to the red basket. The blue, yellow, green, and orange ones are connected to the yellow basket. When one is outputting lower than previous rounds, switch up until you run the other forest dry.
